entries.title: Epic: Shared Flexible Impact, Prestressed Shaft and Vibroacoustic Models
entries.rationale: Shared kernels and numerical qualification can progress, but measured shaft/grip/contact identification, held-out force/spin and radiation validation require unavailable calibrated observations.

prerequisites.name: Equipment-specific shaft/head/grip measurements with calibration and operating-strain evidence
Synchronized force, ball spin/launch and structural-motion measurements over held-out impact positions
Calibrated microphones, observer geometry and independent radiation reference data

acceptance: Identify physical coefficients within a declared frequency/strain/domain band and retain calibration/source hashes and uncertainty.
Independently validate contact force/spin, face/hosel/shaft response and observer pressure; numerical convergence alone is insufficient.
Coordinate blinded sweetness work through UpstreamDrift; publish no physical/player effect size without traceable held-out evidence.

entries.title: [SUBEPIC][TOOLS-M12] Qualification and open release
entries.rationale: Recorded-rig fixtures and hardware camera-count/disconnect evidence require access to real rigs; determinism, property tests and packaging remain executable.

prerequisites.name: Named camera rigs, operators and authorized sanitized recordings
Frozen camera/mode/topology matrix and measured timing/storage metadata

acceptance: Capture known-rig fixtures and camera-count/disconnect behavior with provenance; coordinate with UpstreamDrift capture tooling.
Measure hardware performance/storage budgets and retain failures, unsupported modes and exact configuration.
Do not treat synthetic fixtures or skipped hardware lanes as rig qualification.

entries.title: EPIC: Qualified Ball Landing, Bounce, Roll, and Ground-Surface Modeling
entries.rationale: Surface defaults remain illustrative until equipment/surface-specific calibration and independent measurements exist.

prerequisites.name: Named ground surfaces with controlled condition metadata
Calibrated ball position/velocity/spin observations and independent trials

acceptance: Record sources, uncertainty and applicability for surface parameters and evaluate held-out bounce/roll trajectories.
Preserve first-contact geometry, terminal spin and carry/total-distance semantics; do not relabel illustrative presets as calibrated.
